params.name: Debug: performance log
params.tooltip:
Off: normal play. On: every 30 s, Passenger Destinations
writes how long reading the passengers and drawing the
arrows took to the game's log file (stdout.txt, lines
starting with [SQPERF]), plus its per-refresh arrow log.
Only for tracking down slowdowns; leave it Off otherwise.
Slow calls are always logged briefly, whatever this setting.
